responsibility: Implements the mechanics for changing function signatures and rewriting call sites and bodies to match. It tracks parameter-adjustment summaries for cloned edges, rewrites PARM_DECL uses, SSA names, debug info, and call operands, and provides the body-modification utilities used by IPA-SRA, clone materialization, and other signature-changing passes.
same_name_distinction: Implements the actual signature/body rewrite machinery behind ipa-param-manipulation: it tracks per-edge modification summaries, rewrites formal parameters, calls, expressions, SSA names, and debug statements, and finalizes associated state. Unlike gcc/ipa-param-manipulation.h, it is the transformation code, not the adjustment model and class/interface declarations.
